text: Housing animals rather than leaving them fully free-ranging improves both health and production. For health: housed animals have less contact with sick animals and are less likely to ingest bacteria, virus, and especially parasites that survive and develop in soil. For production: housing young animals reduces predator risk, and animals that don't have to walk to find feed save energy; housed animals can also be given a well-balanced diet and clean water, unlike scavenging animals.
